protocol.task: Motion-only. Refit per held-out physical site. All four sites were seen by the wider project; no independent pose-network validation.
protocol.coordinates: Annotated pedestrian ground positions in metres, downsampled from 30 to 10 Hz without interpolation, with the project's calibration-based Y orientation.
protocol.windows: Five complete observations (0.4 s span), then 30 complete targets (3.0 s). Within each clip/person, split at missing or nonfinite frames and take consecutive, disjoint 35-frame blocks from each run's start. Drop short remainders.
protocol.constant_velocity: Least-squares velocity from all five history positions; extrapolate from the last observed point.
protocol.ridge: Eight coordinates of four observed positions relative to the last position predict 60 future coordinates. Z-score features and center targets using only the three training sites. Unpenalized intercept; fixed ridge alpha 1.0 on summed squared loss. No validation or tuning.
protocol.metrics: Both models scored on the identical test windows. ADE is mean Euclidean distance over all 30 steps; FDE is distance at 3.0 s. Means within site weight windows equally; macro weights the four sites equally. No independence assumption or significance test.
